blocks.text: Bugun da sizderdi academician K. Karasaev atyndagy Bishkek mamlekettik universityinin ozүnүn teren bilimi, zhogorku kesipkoyluguzhana adamgerchiligi menen aiyrmalangan aldynky okutuuchularynin biri menen taanyshtyruunu ulantabyz.

Eric Sadykovich - philosophy ilimderinin doctor, BMUnun professor, Kyrgyz Republic sonyn ilimine emgek sinirgen ishmer, Kyrgyz Republic son Socialdyk kyzmatkerler zhana practitioner psychologist dor association sonn presidenti, oshondoy ele university karashtuu “Umut” socialdyk-psychologylyk borborunun director bolup emhektenet. Al uchurda Socialdyk-psychologylyk facultyinin socialdyk kyzmat zhana practicelyk psychology departmentsynyn zhetekchisi.

Professor Orozaliev socialdyk kyzmat zhana psychology tarmaktarynyn olkodө kalyptanyshyna zhana onүgүshүno zor salym koshup kele zhatat. Al - philosophy, psychology zhana socialdyk ish bagytyndagy koptogon ilimiy emgekterdin to the author.

Erik Sadykovichtin zhuzdogon shakirtteri, student, master's student zhana doctoral student ana teren urmattashat zhana chyn yklastan baalashat. Al kesiptesterinin arasynda da chon abroygo zhana sy-urmatka uh. Anyn sabaktary ar dayym teren mazmunduu zhana taasirduu otot. Ozunun bai tazhryybasyn student menen bolushүp, alarms ruhaniy baaluuluktarga, adamgerchilikke zhana ilimge umtuluuga shyktandyryp kelet
